# Beegen
> The sales operating system for Mexican small businesses. A free CRM is the hub; every service is a module bought separately; a WhatsApp AI agent that acts (books, quotes, charges, invoices, reminds, asks for reviews) rather than just replying.

Tagline: "Meta te contesta. Beegen te vende." (Meta answers you. Beegen sells for you.)

Beegen is built for micro and small businesses in Mexico that sell on WhatsApp. Every lead from a web form, WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger or a call lands in one CRM with a per-contact timeline. One AI agent (powered by Claude) works those leads across channels and can take actions through the modules the business has enabled. Copy is Spanish first, with an English toggle. Prices are in MXN with IVA (VAT) included.

## Modules and pricing (MXN per month, IVA included)
- CRM (`crm`): free forever, 1 seat included, unlimited contacts (fair use), pipeline, tasks, import. $99 per extra seat. Available now. https://beegen.co/crm
- Sitio web / Website (`site`): $149 per published site. AI-built site with pages, contact form and WhatsApp button; unlimited edits (fair use), custom domain. Every form submission creates a contact in the CRM. Available now. https://beegen.co/sitio-web
- Agente de WhatsApp / WhatsApp agent (`wa_agent`): $299 per number, 500 AI conversations per month included, $1.50 per extra conversation. Answers, qualifies, books, quotes, charges and hands off to a human with context. Available now. https://beegen.co/whatsapp
- Recordatorios y seguimientos / Reminders (`reminders`): $99, 200 template messages included, Meta cost + 20% per extra. Appointment reminders, payment nudges, follow-ups via Meta-approved templates. Coming soon. https://beegen.co/recordatorios
- Cobros / Payments (`payments`): $0 monthly + 1% per payment collected (plus processor fees). Payment links from the chat or a deal; card, OXXO, SPEI, interest-free installments via Stripe, Conekta or Mercado Pago. Coming soon. https://beegen.co/cobros
- Facturación CFDI / Invoicing (`invoicing`): $149, 50 folios included, $2 per extra folio. The agent collects RFC, postal code, tax regime and CFDI use and stamps the invoice through a SAT-authorized PAC. Coming soon. https://beegen.co/facturacion
- Reseñas Google / Google reviews (`reviews`): $99. Asks for a Google review after a booking or payment with the direct link. Coming soon. https://beegen.co/resenas
- Instagram y Messenger (`social_channels`): $99 per connected account; shares the WhatsApp agent's conversation quota. Coming soon.
- Voz / Voice (`voice`): $299, 100 minutes included, $3 per extra minute. Calls to the WhatsApp number handled by the agent. Coming soon.
- Cotizaciones / Quotes (`quotes`): $99. PDF quotes from a chat or deal with accept-and-pay link. Coming soon.

## Bundles
- Beegen Ventas: $499 per month. WhatsApp agent (1 number), reminders, payments, Google reviews, CRM with 3 seats.
- Beegen Negocio: $899 per month. Every module, 2 WhatsApp numbers, CRM with 5 seats.
- Annual prepay: 12 months for the price of 10, payable at OXXO or by SPEI in one payment.
- Done-for-you onboarding: $999 to $1,999 one-time (site built, number connected, knowledge loaded, templates approved).

## Trials and billing
- Every module has an independent 14-day free trial, no card required.
- Seats are only charged for the CRM and shared inbox ($99 per extra seat); the website and the agent do not charge per user.
- Usage overages are billed at the end of the month and shown in real time in the dashboard.
- Beegen issues a CFDI invoice for every payment.
- Existing Starter/Pro website plans map to the Website module; existing WhatsApp slots map to the WhatsApp agent.
